title: Air AI Pricing in 2026 for 10,000 Minutes a Month
summary: Air AI pricing combines monthly plan fees with per-minute usage charges. See the per-tier cost breakdown to calculate total spending and choose your plan.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


Because the pricing page can move between pilot and signature, none of the answers below is confirmed. Each says what to ask, and each is marked unverified rather than guessed.


### Trials, billing and cancellation


Does Air AI have a free plan or free trial? Unverified: I couldn't confirm a free plan or trial from Air AI's own pricing page.


Ask for a written pilot allowance, because testing on your own call volume is what exposes the real per-minute cost, and a demo won't.


Does Air AI charge per minute or per call? Usage is billed per minute on top of the plan or licence fee, which is the structure this article prices against.


Whether failed, unanswered or voicemail calls bill is unverified. Get it in writing, because those calls would otherwise be a cost you absorb on the invoice.


Can you cancel Air AI at any time? Unverified. Ask three things before signing: the minimum term, whether the licence fee is refundable once paid, and how renewal notice works.


An upfront fee you can't recover is a sunk cost, and it should be priced into the client's retainer before you commit.


### Competitor comparison and price changes


Is Air AI cheaper than Vapi or Retell? That depends on your monthly minutes, and I can't confirm it for Air AI.


Vapi and Retell publish their rates on their own pricing pages, so their side is checkable today. Price all three at the same volume, with telephony and QA included, and compare the totals. Don't compare the headline rates.


How often does Air AI change its pricing? Unverified: I found no published change history. Treat the page as something that can move, and take a dated quote or order form that fixes your rate for the term.


Otherwise a shared account can end up quietly subsidizing a client who should be paying more.
